context: A uni student listens to a teen friend share a fun story
purpose: Teach: 判ら/ヘルプ/あいまい/ステキ/ジョーク/ボリューム/終始/輝く

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、聞いてくださいよ、昨日のクラス会、終始爆笑だったんです！
lines.en: Senpai, listen — yesterday's class meeting was nonstop laughter from start to finish!
lines.style: Bubbly teen voice, excited rising intonation, casual respectful tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、何があったの?ちょっと話のあいまいなところ補ってよ。
lines.en: Oh? What happened? Fill in the vague parts of the story for me.
lines.style: Relaxed university student, warm curious tone, slightly amused

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 担任の田中先生がですね、いきなりマイクのボリューム最大にして登場したんですよ!
lines.en: Our homeroom teacher Tanaka suddenly appeared with the mic volume cranked to maximum!
lines.style: Animated storytelling voice, building excitement, expressive girl tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それ、ちょっと意味が判らないんだけど、なんでそんなことに?
lines.en: I don't really get the meaning of that — why on earth did that happen?
lines.style: Puzzled laughing tone, casual male voice, gently teasing

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 誰かのジョークで音響係がヘルプ求めてたら、先生が乱入してきて、目がキラキラ輝くんですよ!
lines.en: Because of someone's joke the sound staff called for help, then the teacher barged in with sparkling eyes!
lines.style: Rapid-fire excited girl, gesturing voice, climbing pitch

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うわ、それは絶対ステキな光景だな。動画とか撮ってないの?
lines.en: Wow, that must have been a wonderful sight. Didn't anyone film it?
lines.style: Impressed amused male, leaning-in interested tone, soft chuckle

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 撮りましたよ!クラスのグループに流したら、もう既読の嵐で!
lines.en: I totally filmed it! When I sent it to the class group chat, the read receipts exploded!
lines.style: Triumphant proud teen voice, giggling, fast-paced delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいなあ、高校って本当に毎日楽しそうだね。俺にも今度見せてよ。
lines.en: Nice — high school really sounds fun every single day. Show it to me next time too.
lines.style: Nostalgic warm male voice, smiling tone, gentle encouragement
